description: This data is published by Assem ELTanany, Mariam; Aly Hany, Nermine; Mossad Hannalla, Gihan. Spatial resolution is not established here. The data period and sampling interval are not fully established. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists CSV, PNG, DSB, JPG, XLSX, DOCX, PDF; these files were not downloaded. Licence: cc-by-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The deposit title says Marsa Matruh, while its description says El-Alamein Campus. This location discrepancy is retained and must be resolved before use. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
